nodes.summary: For an encoding $E$ of a finite TM2 machine $M$, a stack $k$ and a natural number $c$, the decoded symbol is the effective symbol of stack $k$ with index $c - 1$ when $1 \le c$ and $c - 1 < s_k$, where $s_k$ is the size of the effective alphabet of stack $k$; otherwise, in particular for $c = 0$, it is $\bot$ (no symbol).
nodes.title: Decoding a symbol code

nodes.summary: For a finite TM2 machine $M$, the window depth is the maximum, over all labels $l$ of $M$, of the largest number of push, peek and pop nodes on a root-to-leaf path of the statement tree of $l$.

nodes.title: Encoding data for a finite TM2 machine

nodes.summary: For an encoding $E$ of a finite TM2 machine $M$ with $K$ numbered stacks and symbol-code bound $g$, the number of window combinations is $G = g^{K d}$, where $d$ is the window depth of $M$.
nodes.title: Number of window combinations

nodes.summary: For an encoding $E$ of a finite TM2 machine $M$, the symbol-code bound is $g = 1 + \max_k s_k$, where the maximum runs over all stacks $k$ of $M$ and $s_k$ is the size of the effective alphabet of stack $k$.
nodes.title: Symbol-code bound

nodes.summary: For an encoding $E$ of a finite TM2 machine with $A_0$ label/state codes and $G$ window combinations, the label/state code of a situation $i \in \mathbb{N}$ is $\lfloor i / G \rfloor \bmod A_0$, the top digit of $i$ in the mixed radix whose lower digits are the window symbol codes.
nodes.title: Label/state code of a situation

nodes.summary: For an encoding $E$ of a finite TM2 machine $M$, the layout of the transition clauses has label/state block size $A = A_0 + N$, where $A_0$ is the number of label/state codes and $N = A_0 G$ is the number of situations ($G$ the number of window combinations), together with the number $K$ of numbered stacks, the symbol-code bound $g$ and the window depth $d$ of $M$. The block is a one-hot part on $[0, A_0)$ followed…
nodes.title: Clause layout of a machine encoding

nodes.summary: For an encoding $E$ of a finite multi-stack Turing machine $M$, the number of situations is $N = A_0 \cdot G$, where $A_0$ is the number of (label, state) codes of $E$ and $G$ is the number of window combinations.
nodes.title: Number of situations

nodes.summary: For an encoding $E$ of a finite multi-stack Turing machine $M$ and a natural number $i$, the next label/state code of situation $i$ is the code, in the (label, state) numbering of $E$, of the pair formed by the label and the state that the effect of situation $i$ produces.
nodes.title: Next label/state code of a situation

nodes.summary: For a statement tree $q$ of a multi-stack Turing machine, $\operatorname{ops}(q)$ is the largest number of push, peek and pop nodes on a path from the root of $q$ to a leaf. Load and branch nodes do not count, and goto and halt leaves contribute $0$.
nodes.title: Stack operations on a path of a statement tree

nodes.summary: Let $q$ be a statement tree of a multi-stack Turing machine with state type $\sigma$, let $k$ be a stack and $x$ a symbol of the alphabet of $k$. Then $x$ can be pushed onto $k$ by $q$ when $q$ contains a push node onto stack $k$ with symbol function $f$ and some state $v \in \sigma$ satisfies $x = f(v)$. Every push node of $q$ counts, whichever branches are taken.
nodes.title: Symbols a statement tree can push

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
